mapper.select: select c.id, c.boarding_record_id, c.note, p.id as pet_id, p.name as pet_name, p.type , o.id as owner_id, o.name as owner_name from care_notes c inner join boarding_records b on c.boarding_record_id = b.id inner join pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id inner join owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id where boarding_record_id = #{ownerId}
